title: Maamba Private School hybrid solar system
summary: A 57.20 kWp solar PV and 51.20 kWh lithium battery hybrid system providing reliable, clean power for Maamba Private School.
scope: Supply of PV modules, hybrid inverters and lithium batteries
challenge: A school needs dependable power for classrooms, offices, ICT and lighting, without lessons being disrupted by supply interruptions or rising energy costs.
solution: Donmac engineered a 57.20 kWp solar array with 51.20 kWh of lithium storage on hybrid inverters, so the school draws on solar by day and stored energy during outages.
outcomes: Reliable power for teaching and administration
Cleaner energy for the school community
